title: One viewer, many projects
summary: One local viewer reads every registered project; the browser only ever asks, and the agent in each project does the work.

nodes.label: Home page #/
nodes.detail: Every registered project as a card, its tracks grouped **Now / Open / Done / Archived**, with search and status filters kept in the URL.

nodes.label: Track pages
nodes.detail: The existing plan, spec, diagrams and feedback views, now under `#/<project>/<track_id>/…`. Archived tracks are read-only.

nodes.label: serve.py
nodes.detail: One per machine. Port from `--port`, then `CONDUCTOR_VIEW_PORT`, then `config.json`, then **4177**. A second start registers its project with this one and exits.

nodes.label: Find projects
nodes.detail: Scans folders you choose, a few levels deep, for `conductor/index.md`. Skips `.git`, `node_modules`, virtualenvs and hidden folders.

nodes.label: projects.json
nodes.detail: The list of registered projects. Lives in `~/.config/conductor-view/` (Linux), `~/Library/Application Support/conductor-view/` (macOS) or `%APPDATA%\conductor-view\` (Windows). Never inside a repo.

nodes.label: config.json
nodes.detail: Viewer-wide preferences, starting with the saved `port`.

nodes.label: conductor/ (project A)
nodes.detail: `tracks.md`, `tracks/`, and now `archive/` too. The viewer reads them; it writes only `feedback.md` and `settings.json`.

nodes.label: conductor/ (project B)
nodes.detail: Any number of projects, each in its own repo.

nodes.label: Claude · Codex · …
nodes.detail: Sees an `archive`, `restore` or `delete` request in `feedback.md`, moves the folder, updates `tracks.md`, commits, and resolves the item. Asks once more in chat before a delete.
